scenario_description:
Objective: Use a one-evening practice extra to gain targeted form feedback during an already planned indoor session.
Emerging Need: A tentative camera opportunity becomes actionable only after the actual slots, claim method, and cutoff appear.
Decision Context: His recent practice-note file is needed to choose the slot likely to capture the late-session issue rather than an unhelpful warm-up clip.
Consequence: Timely coordination could add a no-cost learning benefit; doing nothing merely leaves the practice unchanged once the slots are gone.

parameter.subject: Thursday ladder extras still forming
parameter.body: For tomorrow's indoor ladder night, a visiting camera mentor might offer brief side-view form clips after the second end if the setup is confirmed. No signup is open yet; exact availability will be posted tomorrow morning.

parameter.content: Camera mentor is confirmed for tonight. Two adult-member side-view clip slots are open at 7:10 p.m. and 7:25 p.m.; members can claim one by texting me before 4:00 p.m. with a preferred time. No fee, first confirmed replies get them.
Both side-view clip slots for tonight are now taken, and the camera mentor is not keeping a cancellation list. Regular ladder practice is still on as scheduled.
